messages:
mike-hr: Heads up folks  jamie-newhire starts next Wednesday. Need to confirm I-9 approach and payroll forms. Jamie is international (work-authorized), so verify which docs they'll present.
elaine-payroll: For international hires with EAD, we accept List A (EAD card) or List B + C. If they have a passport + I-94 that's also fine. We also need completed W-4 and state tax form before first payroll run. Jamie, do you have your I-94 or EAD card?
sam-recruiter: Jamie said they have passport + I-94. Prefers to do a remote I-9 via company-approved notary in their city. They also requested remote onboarding materials in advance.
jamie-newhire: Confirmed passport + I-94. Notary option works; I can do Wed morning. Also would like to review benefits summary ahead of day 1.
onboard-bot: "Reminder: Onboarding packet sent to jamie-newhire. Orientation scheduled: Wed 09:30-12:00 ET."
mike-hr: Payroll note: we need SSN or ITIN for payroll. If they don't have SSN yet, payroll can set up an exception but taxes may be affected. Elaine, can payroll accept ITIN temporarily?
elaine-payroll: Yes, we can process with ITIN but need documentation. Share secure upload link. Also set employee pay schedule to next cycle and mark as "manual review" until forms are complete.
sam-recruiter: I'll confirm notary and send Jamie a checklist: passport, I-94, signed offer, and proof of address for shipping. Also confirm whether they need shipping address for laptop.
jamie-newhire: Shipping address: 450 Pine Rd, Apt 501. I uploaded passport scan to portal.
mike-hr: Day-1 run of show (draft):
- 09:30 Welcome + culture
- 10:00 Payroll & benefits (Elaine)
- 10:30 Security + IT setup (Sam)
- 11:00 Team intro and manager 1:1
- 11:30 Local compliance + visa paperwork overview
Please check for missing items.
elain-payroll: (typo) meant "elaine-payroll" here. Also, Jamie please complete direct deposit form in portal.
sam-recruiter: IT note: We'll provide a temporary cloud workstation access if hardware is delayed due to international shipping. Jamie, do you need a dock?
jamie-newhire: No dock. Temporary cloud host would be great if the laptop is delayed.
onboard-bot: "Task update: hardware request HR-HW-890 created. ETA imaging 48h."
mike-hr: Action items summary:
- sam-recruiter: confirm notary and proxy schedule (due Mon)
- elaine-payroll: send secure upload link for SSN/ITIN and W-4 forms (due today)
- jamie-newhire: upload SSN/ITIN or documents, complete direct deposit (due Tue)
Thanks team. We'll monitor and reconvene if anything stalls.
